text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking alone, I came 
across Hishi Amazon looking troubled over 
something.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's you... Hey, could you lend me an 
ear for a bit? I need some advice. My late 
surges haven't been going well lately.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Even if I wanted to burst straight 
through, the path ahead is totally 
blocked, so I can't make a move.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Man, what are you even supposed to do in a 
situation like that?
choice_data_list: Overwhelm the rivals with pure spirit
Try making a sweeping pass on the outside.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
So to win with your running, you gotta win 
in your heart too! Fair enough, you've 
definitely got a point there.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
It's embarrassing to admit, but without 
getting results, I guess I was starting to 
lose confidence.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
All right! Guess I'll pump myself up even 
more and hit the track!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
From the outside... True, that might be 
one way to handle it!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Taking the long way around might cost me 
distance, but all I gotta do is run faster 
to make up for it!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...Alright, I've gotta train my body 
thoroughly so I can win even if I take the 
wide turn!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
First, let's review your basic training! 
When push comes to shove, daily discipline 
is what truly counts!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, that was a huge help! I bet I can 
pull off a great result in my next race!
